scripts.clean: rm -rf src/rapidhash && rm -rf generated/ && mkdir -p generated
scripts.generate: bun run clean && bun run clone:rapidhash && bun run generate:v1 && bun run generate:v2
scripts.generate:v1: bun run checkout:rapidhash rapidhash_v1.0 && bun run src/index.ts v1
scripts.generate:v2: bun run checkout:rapidhash rapidhash_v2.0 && bun run src/index.ts v2
